description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'BasicUserRoleManagerTest' that verifies the functionality of the BasicUserRoleManager within the OrangeHRM project. The tests cover user role management, access control, permissions, and configuration retrieval, specifically for the Authorization Manager component. It sets up mock services and tests various user scenarios including admin, supervisor, and ESS, assessing methods related to entity access, roles, permissions, and homepage configurations.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManagerTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for validating the behavior of BasicUserRoleManager, covering access control, role filtering, permissions, homepage default pages, and related functionalities within the OrangeHRM HR management system.
